structure: Part 25, Check answers: the 21 traces of check-answers.fit.spec.js (8 describe blocks: summary rows 2, section structure 3, documents section 1, exit answers 3, change links 2, navigation and submission 3, unfinished notification 5, submitted notification 2), read alongside the spec file for test titles and assertions. Each trace is referred to below by the five-hex hash in its folder name (check-answers-check-answer-<hash>-...-features), and actions by their call id. Every trace was unpacked and its action list, DOM snapshots and network log read. Pages reached: (1) the review page 'Review your notification' at /live-animals/notifications/<ref>/notification-view, in three states: unfinished draft (19 traces, all starting from a fresh notification with only the origin page answered, some with the origin or reason for import page answered further), completed draft (48ae8, 14d3d) and submitted read-only (48ae8, 14d3d); (2) the origin page in change mode (origin?change=1, ab722); (3) the accompanying-documents page in change mode (af24a); (4) the Declaration page (48ae8, 14d3d), reached by Continue on a complete review; (5) a confirmation URL seen only in the network log. Layout of the review, in order: journey strip (status tag + reference), error summary when unfinished, h1, six numbered h2 sections each holding h3 subsection headings above govuk summary cards (h4 titles), section breaks between sections, then a POST form holding only the Continue button. Card sets: unfinished new notification has 8 cards (Import details, Reason for import, Additional animal details, Arrival details, Transport details, Uploaded documents, Roles and addresses, Contact address for this consignment); a complete notification adds a commodity card per line under 'Commodity details' and a Transit countries card. The submitted state drops every Change link and the Continue form and adds Copy as new and Delete. Shared set-up journeys (sign-in, dashboard, origin page, hub, commodity and address pages driven by completeAnswerSections) belong to other parts and are claimed here only where they bear on the review.

claims.statement: The review page lives at /notifications/<reference>/notification-view under the live-animals service and is headed 'Review your notification'.
The review page's browser title is 'Review your notification - Import notification service - GOV.UK' when the notification is complete.
claims.quote: Review your notification - Import notification service - GOV.UK

claims.statement: When the notification is unfinished, the review page's browser title is prefixed 'Error: ', on the first GET as well as after a refused Continue.
claims.quote: Error: Review your notification - Import notification service - GOV.UK

claims.statement: Above the heading, the review shows a journey strip with a status tag and the notification reference in bold; a draft shows a blue 'Draft' tag.
A submitted notification's review shows a green 'Submitted' tag in the journey strip in place of Draft.

The review is laid out as six numbered level-2 sections in this order: '1. About the consignment', '2. Description of the goods', '3. Transport and arrival', '4. Documents', '5. Consignment parties', '6. Contact address'.
claims.quote: 1. About the consignment | 2. Description of the goods | 3. Transport and arrival | 4. Documents | 5. Consignment parties | 6. Contact address

claims.statement: The six sections carry anchor ids: about-the-consignment, description-of-the-goods, transport-and-arrival, documents-section, consignment-parties and contact-address-section.
A visible section break (govuk-section-break--l --visible) separates each numbered section from the next.

Every card on the review sits under its own level-3 subsection heading; on a new notification the subsection headings are, in order: 'Where is this consignment coming from?', 'Main reason for import', 'Additional details', 'Arrival details', 'Transport details', 'Upload documents', 'Roles and addresses', 'Contact address for this consignment'.
claims.quote: Where is this consignment coming from? | Main reason for import | Additional details | Arrival details | Transport details | Upload documents | Roles and addresses | Contact address for this consignment

claims.statement: Card titles are level-4 headings, one per summary card, so the number of level-4 headings equals the number of cards.

A brand-new notification's review shows eight cards: Import details, Reason for import, Additional animal details, Arrival details, Transport details, Uploaded documents, Roles and addresses, and Contact address for this consignment.
claims.ref: trace 71d37 actions call@837 to call@857; trace 11c41 action call@663
claims.quote: Import details | Reason for import | Additional animal details | Arrival details | Transport details | Uploaded documents | Roles and addresses | Contact address for this consignment

claims.statement: With no commodity line, section 2 shows no 'Commodity details' subsection or commodity card at all; only 'Additional details' stands.
claims.quote: 2. Description of the goods / Additional details / Additional animal details

claims.statement: Once a commodity line exists, section 2 shows a 'Commodity details' subsection with one card per line, titled '<common name> (<commodity code>) — <species>'.
The commodity card lists Commodity code, Common name, Species, Number of animals and Number of packages.
claims.quote: Commodity code 0102 | Common name Cow | Species Bos taurus | Number of animals 1 | Number of packages 5

claims.statement: Inside the commodity card, an 'Animal details' level-5 heading introduces a table with columns 'Animal' and 'Ear tag', one row per animal.
claims.quote: Animal details | Animal | Ear tag | Animal 1 | UK123456789012

claims.statement: The commodity card's Change link is named 'Change commodity 1' for screen readers and goes to consignment-details?change=1; the card has no anchor id, unlike every other card.
When the transport route has transit countries, section 3 adds a 'Transit countries' subsection and card between Arrival details and Transport details; with none recorded the card is absent.
claims.ref: trace 48ae8 action call@1239; trace 8f3d8 action call@947
claims.quote: Transit countries | Countries that the consignment will travel through | France, Belgium
claims.note: The spec file says the transit-countries group waits on an overland arrival; the traces only show it present after Road Vehicle arrival with two countries added.

claims.statement: Transit countries are listed in one row, 'Countries that the consignment will travel through', as a comma-separated list.
The Import details card lists rows Country of origin, Region of origin code required, Region of origin code and Internal reference number.
claims.quote: Country of origin | Region of origin code required | Region of origin code | Internal reference number

claims.statement: Country of origin reads back as the country name, and 'Region of origin code required' reads back as Yes or No.
claims.quote: Country of origin France | Region of origin code required Yes

claims.statement: The region of origin code reads back joined to the country prefix with a hyphen: suffix 'IDF75' entered for France shows as 'FR-IDF75', and '75' shows as 'FR-75'.
claims.ref: trace 17c14 actions call@813 and call@829; trace 48ae8 action call@1239

claims.statement: A five-character region suffix (eight characters joined) is accepted and saved.
claims.quote: Five characters after the prefix — the joined code is eight, which the old whole-code cap made impossible.

claims.statement: The internal reference the trader entered reads back as typed under 'Internal reference number'.
In a card that is finished, a blank optional or not-asked answer is written out as 'Not applicable' (region code when not required; internal reference left blank).
claims.quote: Region of origin code Not applicable | Internal reference number Not applicable

claims.statement: In a card that still has answers outstanding, every blank row has no visible text and carries only a visually hidden 'Missing' (class app-summary-list__value--missing), never 'Not applicable'.
claims.ref: trace 9adee actions call@1009 to call@1011; trace 11c41 actions call@667 to call@669

claims.statement: Whether a blank reads 'Not applicable' or the hidden 'Missing' depends on whether its card is complete, not on whether that particular answer is required.
claims.quote: the difference is the card around it, not whether that particular answer was required

claims.statement: The Reason for import card on an unanswered notification shows one row, 'Reason for import', marked missing.
The reason for import reads back by its label, for example 'Internal market', 'Transit', 'Temporary admission horses' and 'Re-entry'.
claims.ref: trace 48ae8 action call@1239; trace 8f3d8 call@947; trace d7a6d call@781; trace a28b3 call@901
claims.quote: Internal market | Transit | Temporary admission horses | Re-entry

claims.statement: For Internal market, the Reason for import card adds a 'Purpose in the market' row.
For Transit, the Reason for import card shows 'Destination country' as the country name and 'Port of exit' as port name with code, and no Exit date row.
claims.quote: Destination country Ireland | Port of exit Port of Dover (GB DVR)

claims.statement: For Temporary admission horses, the Reason for import card shows 'Exit date' and 'Port of exit', and no Destination country row.
claims.ref: trace d7a6d actions call@783 to call@787
claims.quote: Exit date 27/3/2026 | Port of exit Port of Dover (GB DVR)

claims.statement: For Re-entry, none of Destination country, Exit date or Port of exit appears on the review.
claims.ref: trace a28b3 actions call@903 to call@907

claims.statement: Dates read back as day/month/year with no leading zeros.
claims.ref: trace d7a6d action call@783; trace 48ae8 action call@1239

claims.statement: The exit answers sit inside the Reason for import card and carry no link of their own; the card heading's Change link reaches them.
The Additional animal details card shows 'Certified for' and, once answered, 'Includes unweaned animals'; unanswered it shows only 'Certified for', marked missing.
claims.ref: trace 48ae8 action call@1239; trace 11c41 action call@663
claims.quote: Certified for Slaughter | Includes unweaned animals No

claims.statement: The Arrival details card lists Port of entry, Arrival date at port of entry, Means of transport to the port of entry, Transport identification and Transport document reference.
claims.quote: Port of entry Aberdeen Harbour (GB ABD) | Arrival date at port of entry 7/11/2026 | Means of transport to the port of entry Road Vehicle | Transport identification FR-892-LK | Transport document reference CMR-2026-884721

claims.statement: On an unanswered notification, the Transport details card shows only a 'Type' row, marked missing.
Once a transporter is chosen, the Transport details card lists Name, Address (multi-line), Country, Approval number and Type.
claims.quote: Name García Livestock Transport SL | Address 43 East Hague Extension ... | Country Switzerland | Approval number ES-T2-45001294 | Type Commercial

claims.statement: The Roles and addresses card lists Place of origin, Consignor, Consignee, Importer and Place of destination.
claims.quote: Place of origin | Consignor | Consignee | Importer | Place of destination

claims.statement: Each chosen party reads back as an address block: name in bold, then address lines, postcode, country, telephone and email, each on its own line.
claims.quote: Astra Rosales / 43 East Hague Extension / Bern / 30055 / Switzerland / 01632 960000 / astra-rosales@example.com

claims.statement: Once answered, the Roles and addresses card adds a 'County parish holding (CPH) number' row showing the county, parish and holding parts run together, with no row action.
claims.ref: trace 48ae8 actions call@1165 to call@1169 and call@1239

claims.statement: On a complete draft, each party row and the contact address row carry an 'Edit details' row action to that party's edit page with return=notification-view, named for screen readers as '<party> (<card>)'.
claims.quote: <A class="govuk-link" href="/live-animals/notifications/GBN-AG-26-QQ1X0N/consignors/edit?return=notification-view">Edit details <SPAN class="govuk-visually-hidden"> consignor (Roles and addresses)
claims.note: The edit routes seen are place-of-origin/edit, consignors/edit, consignees/edit, importers/edit, destinations/edit and consignment/contact/edit. This sits beside the rule that no summary row carries a Change link, which the traces only test on a new notification.

claims.statement: The Contact address for this consignment card has one row, 'Contact address', showing the chosen address block.
claims.quote: Contact address Animal and Plant Health Agency / Woodham Lane / Addlestone / KT15 3NB / United Kingdom / 01632 960000 / animal-and-plant-health-agency@example.com

claims.statement: The documents section always appears, even when nothing is uploaded: '4. Documents', subsection 'Upload documents', card 'Uploaded documents'.
claims.ref: trace af24a actions call@837 to call@839

claims.statement: With no documents uploaded, the Uploaded documents card says 'You have not added any documents yet.' and is never marked as unfinished.
claims.quote: You have not added any documents yet.

claims.statement: The Uploaded documents card's Change link ('Change uploaded documents') goes to accompanying-documents?change=1, and following it lands there.
claims.ref: trace af24a actions call@843 to call@847

claims.statement: Opened from the review in change mode, the Upload documents page shows caption 'Documents', heading 'Upload documents', a back link and 'Cancel and return to overview' pointing at the hub, and 'Save and continue' / 'Save and return to overview' buttons.
claims.quote: Upload documents | Save and continue | Save and return to overview | Cancel and return to overview
claims.note: The page's own fields belong to the accompanying-documents part; recorded here only as the Change destination.

claims.statement: Every card carries exactly one Change link, in its heading bar; on a new notification there are as many 'Change' links as cards (eight).
On a new notification no summary row carries a row action (no .govuk-summary-list__actions anywhere on the page).

Each card's Change link goes to the page that collected it with ?change=1: origin, import-reason, additional-details, port-of-entry, transit-countries, transporters, accompanying-documents, addresses and consignment/contact/select.
claims.ref: trace 11c41 action call@663; trace 48ae8 action call@1239

claims.statement: Change links are named for screen readers with the card name in visually hidden text, for example 'Change import details', 'Change reason for import', 'Change arrival details'.
claims.ref: trace ab722 action call@1031; trace 8f3d8 action call@957

claims.statement: The hidden text of a Change link differs by card state: a complete card reads ' <card> (<Card title>)' in a DIV actions block, while an unfinished card (and the Uploaded documents card) reads ' <card>' in a UL/LI actions block.
claims.ref: trace 8f3d8 action call@947 (Import details vs Additional animal details)
claims.quote: import details (Import details) | additional animal details
claims.note: Two markup paths render the same Change link: the govuk summary-card macro and a hand-built error card. A screen-reader user hears two naming patterns on one page.

claims.statement: Following a Change link from the review opens the page pre-filled with the saved answers.
Saving a page reached by a Change link returns the trader to the same review: POST origin?change=1 redirects to notification-view.
claims.ref: trace ab722 actions call@1039 to call@1041 and network log

claims.statement: Clearing an optional answer through a Change link is saved, and the review then shows it as 'Not applicable'.
claims.ref: trace ab722 actions call@1037 and call@1043

claims.statement: In change mode the origin page keeps its normal Back link to the hub, its 'Save and return to overview' button and its 'Cancel and return to overview' link; none of them points back at the review.
The review's Back link goes to the notification hub (/notifications/<reference>).
The trader reaches the review from the hub by the 'Review and submit' button.
The review ends with a POST form holding only the 'Continue' button, directly after the last card: no heading and no sentence sit between them.
The review's form posts a CSRF crumb and a concurrencyToken as hidden fields.
claims.quote: <INPUT type="hidden" name="crumb" value="[REDACTED]"> <INPUT type="hidden" name="concurrencyToken" value="0">

claims.statement: An unfinished notification's review shows a 'There is a problem' error summary as soon as it opens, before the trader presses Continue.
claims.ref: trace 072bf action call@945; trace 11c41 action call@663

claims.statement: The error summary names each unfinished card as 'Complete <card name>', linking to that card's anchor; on a new notification the entries are reason for import, species details, additional animal details, arrival details, transport details, roles and addresses, and contact address for this consignment.
claims.quote: Complete reason for import | Complete species details | Complete additional animal details | Complete arrival details | Complete transport details | Complete roles and addresses | Complete contact address for this consignment

claims.statement: Error summary links point at the card anchors: #reason-for-import, #additional-animal-details, #arrival-details, #transport-details, #roles-and-addresses, #contact-address.
With no commodity line, the error summary names 'Complete species details' and links it to the section anchor #description-of-the-goods, because there is no species card to link to.
claims.ref: trace f53ef actions call@981 to call@983

claims.statement: An answered card drops out of the error summary: after reason for import is saved, 'Complete reason for import' is no longer listed.
claims.ref: trace 8f3d8 action call@947; trace d7a6d action call@781
claims.quote: Complete species details | Complete additional animal details | Complete arrival details | Complete transport details | Complete roles and addresses | Complete contact address for this consignment

claims.statement: Each unfinished card is marked: it gets the app-summary-card--error class and an error message inside it reading 'Error: Complete <card name>', all of it visually hidden.
claims.note: The test asserts the card text is visible, but in the DOM the whole message sits inside govuk-visually-hidden, so sighted users see only whatever styling app-summary-card--error adds.

claims.statement: Import details is not marked unfinished once the origin page is saved, and Uploaded documents is never marked.
Pressing Continue on an unfinished notification is refused: the POST to notification-view returns 400 and re-renders the same review, at the same URL, with the same error summary.
claims.ref: trace 1670e actions call@1145 to call@1149 and network log

claims.statement: A new journey shows no address error before a role has been answered: the Consignor row is marked missing and no 'Correct the address details for the consignor' error appears.
claims.ref: trace a247f actions call@1093 to call@1095
claims.quote: Correct the address details for the consignor
claims.note: The error copy comes from the test's hidden-link assertion; no trace shows it rendered.

claims.statement: Pressing Continue on a complete review redirects to the Declaration page (/notifications/<reference>/declaration).
claims.ref: trace 48ae8 action call@1241 and network log

claims.statement: The Declaration page is headed 'Declaration' and sets out the trader's statements under three level-2 headings.
claims.quote: Declaration | I am the contact for the authorities and located in the UK. | I confirm I am responsible for this consignment. | I confirm that I am accountable for:

claims.statement: The Declaration body text states compliance with Regulation (EU) 2017/625 and responsibility until official checks clear or the consignment reaches its place of destination.
claims.quote: I am complying with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2017/625 including on animal health and welfare. | I am responsible from the submission of this notification to when it enters Great Britain. And I am responsible until it has either: cleared official checks at the border / reached the Place of Destination as stated on the health certificate or notification

claims.statement: The Declaration lists what the trader is accountable for: payment for border controls, re-dispatch, quarantine or isolation costs, and destruction and disposal costs, then two sentences on acting for a third party.
claims.quote: any payment for the official controls at the border | any arrangements to re-dispatch the consignment | any costs needed for quarantine or isolation of consignments | any costs needed for destruction and disposal of consignments, when instructed by the authorities | I am authorised as being accountable for these things if raising notifications on behalf of a third party. | I can legally act on behalf of a third party in relation to the conditions of this declaration.

claims.statement: The trader must tick one checkbox (name declaration, value confirmed) confirming the declaration before Continue.
claims.quote: I confirm that I have reviewed and comply with this declaration and that the information submitted in this notification is true and correct.

claims.statement: The Declaration page shows the date of declaration as today's date in long form.
Submitting the declaration redirects to a confirmation page (/notifications/<reference>/confirmation).
claims.ref: trace 48ae8 action call@1245 and network log

claims.statement: A submitted notification's review is opened from the dashboard by its 'View notification <reference>' link.
A submitted notification's review is read-only: no card carries a Change link or Edit details link, and there is no Continue button or submit form.
A submitted notification's review ends with the last card (Contact address for this consignment).
Below the heading, a submitted notification's review offers a secondary 'Copy as new' button, posting to /notifications/<reference>/copy with copyOrigin=notification-view.
claims.quote: <FORM method="post" action="/live-animals/notifications/GBN-AG-26-QQ1X0N/copy" class="app-form-inline"> ... <INPUT type="hidden" name="copyOrigin" value="notification-view"> ... Copy as new

claims.statement: Beside Copy as new, a submitted notification's review offers a red 'Delete' button: a link styled as a warning button, going to /notifications/<reference>/delete.
A submitted notification's review keeps the Back link to the notification hub.

The review shows no serious or critical axe (wcag2a, wcag2aa) violations for a new draft, for an unfinished draft after a refused Continue, or for a submitted notification; the traced axe runs returned no violations at all.
claims.ref: trace 68b95 action call@925; trace 933b1 finishRun result; trace 14d3d finishRun result
claims.quote: review has no serious or critical axe violations

claims.statement: Outside govuk-frontend, the review uses app-journey-strip (status strip), app-summary-card--error (unfinished card marker), app-summary-list__value--missing (blank-row marker) and app-form-inline (inline copy form); a standard Summary card with an Error message or a Tag could carry some of this.
claims.ref: trace 17c14 action call@819; trace 48ae8 action call@1251

claims.statement: The review is otherwise built from govuk-frontend parts: Summary card, Summary list, Error summary, Error message, Tag, Back link, Button, Button group, Section break and Table.
claims.ref: trace 48ae8 action call@1239; trace 17c14 action call@819
claims.quote: govuk-summary-card | govuk-summary-list | govuk-error-summary | govuk-error-message | govuk-tag | govuk-back-link | govuk-button | govuk-section-break | govuk-table
claims.note: Read from the class names in the rendered main element; no component inventory eval was run.

claims.statement: No trace shows the review with documents uploaded, so how an uploaded document reads back in the Uploaded documents card is unknown.
claims.ref: part 25 traces (all show 'You have not added any documents yet.')

claims.statement: No trace shows a commodity line that is itself incomplete, or several commodity lines, on the review: how a partial species card is marked and how lines are numbered beyond 'commodity 1' is unshown.
No trace shows an address error rendered on the review (a saved address reference that no longer resolves); its placement and full copy are unshown.
No trace shows the confirmation page's content, or what Copy as new and Delete do from the submitted review.
claims.ref: trace 48ae8 (confirmation seen only in the network log)

claims.statement: Only the origin and documents Change links are followed; no trace shows that saving any other page reached by a Change link returns to the review, nor what 'Save and return to overview' does in change mode.
The traces show no backend call made by the review or by submission: the browser network log only shows the frontend routes, so what submission sends onward (and to which service) is unshown.
No trace drives a stale concurrencyToken (a review submitted after another change), so the conflict behaviour on Continue is unshown.
